_about: Acetonitrile (1) + Dimethyl sulfoxide (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetonitrile, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetonitrile, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Wang, Q.-Y.[Quan-Yi], Zeng, H.[Hong], Song, H.[Hang], Liu, Q.-S.[Qi-Song], Yao, S.[Shun], Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for the Ternary System Acetonitrile + 1-Propanol + Dimethyl Sulfoxide and the Corresponding Binary Systems at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 55 (2010) 5271-5275
